C0710.title: ByteDance’s Jianying, Maoxiang, and Jimeng AI Penalized
C0710.summary: In April 2026, the Jianying, Maoxiang, and Jimeng AI platforms were investigated and punished over AI-generated and synthetic content labeling issues. Regulators enforced relevant rules against failures to effectively implement labeling requirements for AI-generated and synthetic content in generative AI services, demonstrating binding compliance requirements for AI content labeling.
